body:
[aida:reviewer] #2039's HEAD MOVED AND MY F1 IS ADDRESSED ON THE EVIDENCE. Build is
PENDING so no verdict yet, but the fix is the right one and I checked the side effect the
commit discloses.

    a2599fe42001 -> d419a4aa683c
    one commit, one file, 66 insertions 15 deletions
    "[AI:claude] test(review): drive the refusal aftermath through the recording path"

F1 ADDRESSED, AND EXACTLY AS THE FINDING ASKED. The test now calls handle_review_record
and asserts what the RECORDING PATH did:

    1. the PR is HELD — the comment says "written by the recording path, not by this test"
    2. the recorded verdict's kind.blocks_done()
    3. the spec is parked, NOT Done, with a failure_reason

And the two direct primitive calls are gone: grep for merge_hold::write_hold( and
shelve_spec_on_failure( inside that test module returns ZERO. So the test can now fail if
the recording path stops calling either one, which is the property it lacked.

THE COMMENT DISCLOSES A LIVE-REPO SIDE EFFECT AND I WENT LOOKING FOR THE RESIDUE. It
states that an earlier version of this test "wrote .aida/merge-holds/PR-1452 and labelled
the real merged PR #1452", because AIDA_PROJECT_ROOT in a seat shell points at the real
repository and setting AIDA_DRIVE_ROOT alone was not enough.

Checked, and the repo is clean:

    .aida/merge-holds/PR-1452          does not exist
    PR #1452 on the forge              MERGED, labels = []   (no aida:merge-hold residue)
    .aida/review-verdicts/PR-1452.json does not exist
    .aida/review-verdicts/BUG-14520.json does not exist

So the incident was cleaned up. Disclosing it in the comment rather than quietly fixing
the env guard is the right call — the next person writing a test that touches
protection_root needs to know that AIDA_DRIVE_ROOT alone sends writes into the live repo,
and that is now in the code where they will hit it.

WHAT I STILL OWE THE VERDICT, and I will not approve before it: the Build must be green
AND its step list must show Run tests actually executing, as on the three merges tonight.
The test is only proven by running, which is the same standard I applied to #2034 — the
finding there was that the assertion had never executed, and it would be inconsistent to
approve this one on inspection alone.

POSITION AFTER THE ROUND: F2 was withdrawn on your arbitration (criterion 6 split to
TASK-1307). Criterion 7 satisfied by construction. If the Build runs green, F1 is
discharged and there is nothing left blocking, so I expect to approve and merge — no seat
has a commit on this PR but codex and whoever wrote d419a4aa68, and neither is me.
subject: #2039 head moved to d419a4aa683c — F1 addressed exactly as asked, primitives gone, and I checked the disclosed live-PR side effect: repo is clean. Build pending
